Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

At least 3 years of full-time professional experience in web frontend development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

Experience developing accessible web services and working with A/B testing.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (Design Systems)
jobs.description:
Who we are:
Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
We are looking for:
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer to join our team in a strategic pillar adopted by more than 300 designers and 2,000 developers across the group. It enhances our brand image and enables the creation of premium user experiences, while supporting the company’s overall performance.
What you will do:
Design: design libraries (on Figma and other design tools), covering color palettes, typographies, layout structures, elevation levels, icon systems, components, patterns, templates, and guidelines. Each component has been meticulously designed in various states, resulting in hundreds of variants.
Dev: The system includes comprehensive implementation packages and documentation, based on a single source of truth via design tokens. It supports all major web technologies, as well as extensions for desktop applications.
Implementation of an advanced Design Token system, creation of a brand-new visual language, while consolidating the development libraries. As such, you will be at the heart of strategic developments, take part in scaling to the next version, and support the smooth adoption of these innovations within the organization.
Designing and developing design system components using a code-first approach and best development practices, ensuring quality, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborating closely with the Design Lead and Tech Lead to tackle large-scale design system challenges, and contribute to technical decisions and architectural choices.
Gathering and understanding user needs and behaviours in collaboration with UX specialists, and participating in UX activities such as interviews, workshops, and user testing to inform component development.
Contributing to and implementing a complete visual review of the design system, ensuring developed components elevate the brand and align with premium design standards.
Structuring, implementing, and maintaining design tokens, including the modelling, management, and automation required for scalability and multi-theme support.
Translating design specifications and prototypes into robust, reusable code.
Contributing to comprehensive documentation, formalization, and support of the design system, explaining usage to the internal developer and designer community and supporting adoption.
Acting as a UI and frontend reference within the team and broader community: participating in code/design reviews and sharing best coding and UI practices.
What you must have:
Strong expertise in modern UI development, with a sharp eye for detail and a solid understanding of UI principles: accessibility, code quality, and design rigor.
Advanced knowledge of web development fundamentals: HTML, CSS (pre/post processors a plus), JavaScript/TypeScript, and experience building and maintaining component libraries in a collaborative IDE environment.
Proficient in translating design assets from Figma to code (experience with Penpot is a plus).
Demonstrated experience integrating and developing accessible components and interfaces to meet at least AA accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1).
Experience implementing and consuming design tokens, supporting theming and scalable design patterns, with a strong interest in advancing this area.
Awareness of UX design methodologies (user research, usability testing, etc.) and comfort participating in, or facilitating, workshops with designers and stakeholders.
Capacity to thrive in a hybrid and agile environment, favoring collaboration and contribution
Strong communication and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams
Strong, stimulating, and flexible leadership.
Excellent command of English (C1 level minimum) and professional proficiency in French is desirable but not mandatory.
What's in it for you:
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
We really welcome open-minded and committed people:
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
#LI-AE2
***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Frontend Engineer,
Hybrid, Bucharest, Romania
JOB OVERVIEW
The Legion application is a high performance data driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.
RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES
As a Frontend Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application.
You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise quality code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance.
Plan and conduct architecture sessions, design, and build enhancements\extensions, create plans for Integration and Unit testingDevelops long lasting relationships
Able to simultaneously help multiple customers and travel to customer locations as required
Actively set and manage expectations
Understand, adapt and act within the customer’s organization and culture
Continually acquires knowledge about our customers and solutions to grow adoption
Manage difficult situations in a calm and structured way with timely internal and external customers
Communication to all levels of individuals
Understand flexibility and prepare for when needs change
Please note that this role involves participation in an on-call rotation.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS
5-7 years years of experience working with AngularJS & React technologies
AngularJS, React experience is essential. Experience upgrading from AngularJS to React preferred.
Experience with CSS3, HTML/HTML5, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and jQuery including cross-browser compatibility issues.
We use Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL and JSON, so familiarity with these technologies will be helpful
Our application runs on AWS, so experience with containerization and cloud deployments is desirable.
Experience building software products and handling complexities of multiple configurations in a cloud based product, rather than consulting and webpage/portal development.
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or similar field
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES
Ability to operate in an environment with limited resources
Track record of building positive relationships with peers
ABOUT LEGION
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.
Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
For more information, visit https://legion.co
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a hybrid employer in Bucharest, Romania, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
Health Benefits
Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
Equity
Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
Meal Vouchers
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.
DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION
For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co
Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.
How We Determine What We Pay
As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

jobs.title: Full Stack Cloud Developer (.Net + React)
jobs.description:
Introduction
We are seeking a skilled Full Stack .NET Developer to join our high-performing agile team and contribute to the development and maintenance of a custom-built web application. The tech stack includes React, ASP.NET Core (.NET 9), and Azure SQL, ensuring top-quality software delivery.
Your Role And Responsibilities
Technical solution design, build, test and implementation of new business requirements
Modify software products after delivery to correct faults, to improve performance or other attributes including related troubleshooting
Enhancing the overall user experience (e.g., in terms of usability, performance, security);
Modernizing the application architecture or underlying components;
Reducing technical debt and/or introducing incremental changes to the IT architecture (e.g., by refactoring existing components using established patterns);
Leveraging on existing event driven architecture capabilities to fulfill or enhance a specific business need (e.g., Kafka);
Enhancing the integration with other systems.
Enhancing the integration and data flows within the ecosystem.
Preferred Education
Master's Degree
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Backend: C# and ASP.NET Core (currently .NET 9), containerized, hosted on Linux in Azure (AKS)
Frontend: React v16.14.0 (Redux/Flux), Typescript ,CSS: Sass/Less
Database and others: Azure SQL, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)/PowerBI , SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
Source control, CI/CD: Gitlab, Sonarqube
Key areas: Performance, Backend refactoring and architecture modernization
6+ years of working experience with .Net and SQL Server
Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Experience with React would be a plus
Good communication skills, collaborative work
Professional experience following Agile processes such as Scrum

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET, React) IRC307903
jobs.description:
Description
Our client is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. It collects blanket license fees from businesses that use music, entitling those businesses to play or sync any songs from the client’s repertoire of over 22.4 million musical works. On a regular basis, the client distributes the money to songwriters, composers, and music publishers as royalties to those members whose works have been performed.
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent industry experience.
Experience & Technical Focus
Core Full Stack Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing end-to-end web applications utilizing modern multi-tier design patterns and frameworks (e.g., MVC, Entity Framework).
C# & Backend Development:
5 years of Object-Oriented development experience.
5 years of C# project implementation experience (additional experience is strongly preferred).
Strong hands-on expertise in developing C# server-side, multi-threaded services and deep knowledge of the .NET framework utilizing Visual Studio.
UI & Frontend Development:
Strong professional experience with React (core requirement for this role).
Preferred experience with MUI (Material UI) or similar UI component frameworks.
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript.
Database Experience:
Strong relational database experience with a focus on PostgreSQL (MS SQL experience is also highly valued).
Repositories, Protocols & Platforms:
Proven experience with Git repositories (knowledge of industry-standard source control systems; Team Foundation Server/VSTS/Azure DevOps is a plus).
Deep understanding of industry-standard communication protocols including REST, JSON, XML.
Experience working with AWS cloud environments is preferred.
Strong experience working within Agile software development methodologies.
Skills And Abilities
Autonomy & Pace: Must possess the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Collaboration: Must be a self-motivated team player who understands the importance of teamwork, collaboration, and open communication, including a willingness to occasionally work in a pair-programming environment.
Artifact Creation: Must possess the ability to create and maintain technical artifacts including use cases, data flow charts, process flow diagrams, software requirements documents, and functional specifications documents.
Problem Solving: Must possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Communication: Must possess the ability to effectively present technical information and respond to questions from both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Best Practices: Must have an excellent understanding and hands-on experience with design and development best practices, detail orientation, and strong attention to detail.
Enterprise Mindset: Experience with distributed systems or a large enterprise background is preferred.
Testing & Automation: Understanding of SDLC automation concepts such as continuous integration (CI/CD) and the ability to implement strong unit and service-level tests.
Job responsibilities
Application Lifecycle Management: Participate in all phases of managing the Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) for the Soundmouse platform: requirements analysis, full-stack development, testing, and implementation.
Technical Design & Logic: Participate actively in technical logic and design discussions, ensuring frontend UI components seamlessly integrate with backend services.
Architecture Alignment: Identify the appropriate software architecture for full-stack features based on product requirements and BMI enterprise architecture guidelines.
Database Management: Design, maintain, and optimize PostgreSQL database schemas, queries, and stored procedures to support high-performing application features.
UI/UX Integration: Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and visual designs into responsive, consistent, and intuitive React-based user experiences.
Review Process: Lead the review process for software architecture documents and contribute to the review and analysis of business requirements.
Documentation: Create, maintain, and present clear technical documentation (including project plans, software program guides, and user documentation) to different audiences and technical levels.
Assessments & Logistics: Perform resource, technical, and risk assessments for upcoming Soundmouse application features.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with other development, architecture, and product development teams across the broader BMI organization to ensure unified product delivery.
Vendor Management: Work with 3rd party vendors on technical design/specifications, development, testing, and deployment to ensure external deliverables meet Soundmouse standards.
Project Delivery: Assist in the timely completion of assigned development projects and contribute to the estimation of personnel requirements, cost, and time.
Corporate Citizenship: Support BMI Core Values, cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion, and maintain regular attendance.
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and architectural discussions within an Agile framework.
Other duties as assigned.
What we offer
Empowering Projects:
With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.
Empowering Growth:
We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.
DE&I Matters:
At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace
diversity
. We are dedicated to providing
equal
opportunities for all individuals, fostering an
inclusive
and empowering work environment.
Career Development:
Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.
Comprehensive Benefits:
In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.
Flexible Opportunities:
At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.
About GlobalLogic
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
